node.title: KoalaBear active balanced-core partition semantic-gap audit
node.closure: finite logical countermodel plus source-contract audit
node.statement: The frozen Grande Finale v4 tangent-source partition proves exact first-match set algebra for arbitrary Q and bcCertified predicates, but supplies no source-bound data or semantic restriction for bcCertified. A one-slope finite countermodel satisfies bad-slope exhaustion, first-owner uniqueness, and pairwise disjointness while Z_BC is nonempty and the endpoint-record set is empty. Therefore the active partition contract alone cannot imply a Z_BC-to-Q6 endpoint bridge. Independently, the K3 source-pencil packets quantify over supplied actual endpoint records and explicitly disclaim received-data, slope, owner, and parameter-to-carrier descent. This is a logical-independence and provenance result, not a counterexample to a future concretely defined balanced-core theorem.
